card.title: Help Me Make This Normal
card.instruction: Get someone to help perform the strange behavior until it feels ordinary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our invisible dinner guest is here. Will you introduce Mum while I finish the gravy?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can't see where to look.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The chair beside you. Just introduce them as you normally would.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Hello, chair, this is Mum. She needs your seat.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Introduce her to the guest, love. Then fetch another chair; we can't ask someone to stand just because Mum can't see them.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 cannot see the guest, so A3 locates the chair; B4 tries to take it for Mum, prompting A5 another chair.

relationship.evidence: B2 faces a genuine perception issue and B4 tries to seat Mum, giving B a practical competing concern.

heightening.evidence: B4 attempts to displace the unseen guest; A5 insists ordinary courtesy requires furniture accommodation, not ignoring the guest.

specificity.evidence: A1 invisible dinner guest and gravy establish a domestic meal; B4 Mum's seating makes the inclusion stakes concrete.
